name: Anti-fraud backend or database is down
message: The backend's /ready check failed 2 times in a row. The API cannot score purchases or the database is unreachable. Check `dc ps` and `dc logs backend` on the server.

name: Anti-fraud scoring is slow
message: p95 scoring latency is above 200 ms over the last 10 minutes (normal is about 20 ms).

name: Anti-fraud gateway returns server errors
message: More than 5 responses with status 5xx in 5 minutes. Check the backend logs in Datadog.

name: Anti-fraud server is low on memory
message: Less than 10% of the server's memory is free for 10 minutes. Consider a larger instance or stopping the Datadog agent.

name: Anti-fraud review queue is growing
message: More than 500 purchases are waiting for an analyst.
